description: Use this when an agent needs to read a web page: one call turns a URL into clean main-content Markdown (navigation, footers, cookie banners and ads stripped) plus title, meta description, canonical URL, language, author, published date, Open Graph and Twitter cards, heading outline, all links (absolute, internal/external), word count and reading time. Follows redirects safely, public hosts only, cached 10 min. Ideal for RAG, summarising, research and link discovery. Returns JSON with: ok, data, sources, fetched_at, cache_age_s. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/web-read

max_chars.description: cap on returned markdown in characters, clamped to 200-120000 (default 40000)

name: web_read
title: Web Read
